map.规格解读（如 225/45R17）：胎宽 225 mm、扁平比 45%、轮辋直径: Spec interpretation (such as 225/45R17): tire width 225 mm, aspect ratio 45%, rim diameter 17 inches. Tire outside diameter (mm) = rim diameter × 25.4 + 2 × tire width × aspect ratio ÷ 100. Diameter change rate = (new diameter ÷ old diameter − 1) × 100%; clearance change = diameter difference ÷ 2 (radial direction); actual speed at an indicated 100 km/h = 100 × (1 + change rate/100). When |change rate| > 3% it may affect ABS/ESP and speedometer accuracy.
map.原规格 225/45R17：外径 = 17×25.4 + 2×225×0.45: Original spec 225/45R17: outside diameter = 17×25.4 + 2×225×0.45 = 431.8 + 202.5 = 634.3 mm. Switching to 235/40R18: outside diameter = 18×25.4 + 2×235×0.40 = 457.2 + 188 = 645.2 mm. The diameter difference is +10.9 mm, the change rate +1.72% (acceptable within ±3%), the clearance change +5.5 mm, and actual speed about 101.7 km/h at an indicated 100 km/h.
map.外径变化过大会改变车速表与里程表读数、影响 ABS/ESP 的轮速判读，还可能蹭: A large diameter change alters speedometer and odometer readings, affects wheel speed interpretation by ABS/ESP, and may rub the wheel arch or change the effective gear ratio. The industry generally treats ±3% as the reference limit for safe modification.
